name: El Maestro Oloroso, 375ml
description: El Maestro Sierra began production in 1832. Jose Antonio Sierra was a carpenter by trade, and established himself as a master barrel-maker, supplying the major sherry houses of the region. He dreamed of producing sherry himself, but such pursuits were largely reserved for nobles. Despite facing prejudice and hardships, Sierra managed to open his own winery, and through talent and perseverance, he made a place for himself in the sherry industry. Solera aged for 15 years, Oloroso as incredibly complex aromas of hazelnuts and exotic spices. This richly textured wine is complex with nuances of nuts and spice.

name: Niepoort LBV Port
tagline: Duoro Valley, PT - 2017 - Touriga Nacional & more
description: Niepoort has been a family-owned winery and Port house since the mid-1800s. They produce many dry table wines, but the star of their show is their Port. Their Late Bottled Vintage is essentially a financial short-cut to getting your hands on aged, vintage port, without the hefty price tag. Whereas most vintage Port is aged two to three years before bottling, LBV sees four to six years in cask. This extra time in cask allows the wine to develop faster than it would in bottle, creating that classic, aged-Port richness and nuttiness you want with your dessert menu.

name: Ostinato Marsala Dolce, 500ml
description: Delicious, balanced and refined, Ostinato Fine Ambra Dolce is a sweet Marsala that is produced according to traditional methods.Enjoy with classic blue-veined cheeses including Gorgonzola, with cookies, or with coffee cake. Explore in cocktails or use to make exceptional desserts, including Italian classics like Tiramisu, Zabaglione, Cassata Cake or Cannoli, in which there is no substitute for Ostinato Dolce. Once opened, this wine will keep for up to six months.

name: Ostinato Marsala Secco, 500ml
description: Delicious, balanced and refined, Ostinato Fine Ambra Secco is a dry Marsala that is produced according to traditional methods. Explore in cocktails or use to make classics like Chicken Marsala. Once opened, this wine will keep for up to six months.

name: Quinta do Infantado Tawny Port
tagline: Gontelho, PT - NV - Tinta Roriz/Touriga Nacional/Touriga Franca/Tinta Barroca
description: Quinta do Infantado might as well be our house Port by now, as it's what we reach for most. Their Tawny is aged in barrels known as 'pipa', which are tall, 550L casks ideal for Tawny production as the barrel promotes oxidation due to its vertical orientation, smaller capacity, and thinner staves. The wine spends four to five years in bottle before release and finishes with around eighty-four grams per liter of residual sugar, making it noticeably drier and more vinous than most Tawny.

name: Rare Wine Co. Baltimore Rainwater Madeira
tagline: Madeira, PT - Verdelho, Tinta Negra - NV
description: Madeira is a fortified wine from the eponymous archipelago in the Atlantic, which is a territory belonging to Portugal. Stylistically similar to Port, it utilizes different grapes and comes from a distictly different terroir. Rare Wine Co. makes a series of Madeira based on what was typically offered in the corresponding city during the United States' colonial era. This Rainwater-style is known for being slightly lighter and drier than other Madeira.
